label: Teltonika RUT241 industrial 4G/LTE IoT router
description: Teltonika RUT241 is a compact DIN-rail industrial 4G LTE Cat 4 router for IoT/M2M and remote-site gateways, running RutOS (OpenWrt) with firewall, NAT, VLANs, IPsec/OpenVPN, MQTT and RMS remote management. It has a real two-port Ethernet switch side: 1x WAN and 1x LAN, both 10/100 Mbps RJ45, plus a 2.4 GHz 802.11 b/g/n access point; the cellular link is LTE, not WiFi, and is described here rather than modelled as an 802.11 interface.
